items.computation: Period start: invoice date 21.11.2026 (Saturday); the day of the event itself is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Counting 14 days forward from 21.11.2026 lands on 05.12.2026 (a Saturday). Since this is a payment deadline, the payer's own Land (NW) rules for the end of the period apply: if the last day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it moves to the next working day (§ 193 BGB). 05.12.2026 is a Saturday and 06.12.2026 a Sunday, 07.12.2026 (Monday) is not a public holiday in NW, so the deadline moves to 07.12.2026.
